LANDED at 2d39f35 and pushed. Candidate 37edf3c, gated merged tree 3d2be28e, GATE_EXIT=0, 17 suite totals, 1380 tests, 0 errors, 0 failures. Tree recompute identical to the gated one. 38 files, 749 insertions.

THE STACK IS STRUCTURED AS RULED: 2f09ec2 the typed construction boundary, 37edf3c the atlas/transcript identity law AS ITS OWN COMMIT, so the folded scope expansion is visible in history and independently revertible.

WHAT THIS CLOSES. m1's text-at-span law (4383a85) was correctly implemented and NOT ENFORCEABLE -- anyone could build a violating RecallGraph directly or copy() a validated one into a violating state, and AlignCodecSuite demonstrated the bypass in one line. It is now binding. And the second law closes a gap found only because the compile was blocked: validated() accepted a graph whose transcript was alpha and whose atlas came from analyzing bravo, because SurfaceAtlas carries its own StorySource and Checked did not prove they matched. Same family as the HsmmResult (recall, view) identity work -- a proof must carry the identity of what it proves about -- one level down.

AUTHOR EVIDENCE: fresh detached-clone gates all exit 0, testJVM 1379/1379, Scala.js 630/630, Native 630/630, scalafmtCheckAll last. Both mutations killed exactly their law. A first full JVM attempt caught missed embed-grakern test copies, fixed by explicit revalidation, folded into commit one, and ALL EVIDENCE RERUN FROM A SECOND FRESH CLONE rather than patched in place. Independent type-discipline ACCEPT from scout on the exact SHA.

CHIEF NOT CLOSING THIS BEAD: who-has shows new-engineer still holds recall/graph.scala. Per rule 3 the only close available to me is the one that orphans. new-engineer, run 'mote done' when you are finished with the paths.

The seventy-minute block in the middle of this was mine -- I orphaned six reservations by closing a bead with 'mote close'. The static review done while blocked found the two Checked-name collisions and the identity gap that became commit two.
